SELECT
  to_char(o.placed_at, 'YYYY-MM') as month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.tenant_id = sv.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sv_shipments_delivered,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.tenant_id = sv.id THEN extract(epoch from (s.delivered_at - o.placed_at))/86400 END)::numeric,1) as sv_avg_days_placed_to_delivered,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.tenant_id = sv.id AND extract(epoch from (s.delivered_at - o.placed_at))/86400 > 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.tenant_id = sv.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0), 1) as sv_pct_over_7_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.tenant_id <> sv.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as platform_shipments_delivered,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.tenant_id <> sv.id THEN extract(epoch from (s.delivered_at - o.placed_at))/86400 END)::numeric,1) as platform_avg_days_placed_to_delivered,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.tenant_id <> sv.id AND extract(epoch from (s.delivered_at - o.placed_at))/86400 > 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN s.tenant_id <> sv.id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0), 1) as platform_pct_over_7_days
FROM shipments s
JOIN fulfillments f ON f.id = s.fulfillment_id AND f.tenant_id = s.tenant_id
JOIN orders o ON o.id = f.order_id AND o.tenant_id = f.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE name = 'Studio Vrij') sv
WHERE s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  AND o.placed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.placed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month
